cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.description: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.description: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

cards.name: Torchic
cards.description: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Chimchar
cards.description: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

cards.name: Tepig
cards.description: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

cards.name: Fennekin
cards.description: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Litten
cards.description: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

cards.name: Scorbunny
cards.description: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon’s body. Once that happens, it’s ready to fight at full power.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.description: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.description: It is small but rough and tough. It won’t hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

cards.name: Mudkip
cards.description: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

cards.name: Chikorita
cards.description: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.description: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

cards.name: Oshawott
cards.description: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.description: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

cards.name: Popplio
cards.description: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It’s famous for being a hard worker.

cards.name: Sobble
cards.description: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won’t be able to resist weeping.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Treecko
cards.description: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.description: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

cards.name: Snivy
cards.description: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

cards.name: Chespin
cards.description: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.description: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

cards.name: Grookey
cards.description: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.description: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander’s life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.
